title: Request: Compatibility w/ Medtronic Guardian Connect 3 Transmitter
symptom: User wants to use the Guardian 3 sensor with xDrip and Nightscout setup to retain phone/smartwatch/cloud upload flexibility but gain Smartguard low BG protection on their pump. They are asking if this is possible or being developed.
evidence_quote: I currently use the G6 and a 640g pump. It would be fantastic to push my integration further and use the Guardian 3 sensor (which as far as I understand upgrades from the v2 with bluetooth integration to connect with their own mobile app) with my xDrip and Nightscout setup to retain the phone/smartwatch/cloud upload flexibility but gain the Smartguard low BG protection on my pump.
